description: One company of the AI data market (Scale AI, Mercor, Surge AI, Appen, Snorkel AI and the rest of the vendor register): its revenue over time read as twelve months, its growth over about a year, and its ranked competitors (the companies that sell at least two of the same things). Or two companies side by side: which ranks higher and on what, their revenue, valuation and funding, and what each sells. Every figure with the publication that stated it.

company.description: The company: its name, its domain or its id on this site.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 10, at most 50).

with.description: A second company to compare it with, the same way.

name: compare_companies
title: Compare AI data companies by the money on record
